scoring.decision: Retain every distinct numbered AppendixB criterion with unit weight; describe scores as adapted61-criterion results, not exact reproduction of the paper60-dimension scores.
scoring.conditional_correctness: confirmed_correct_count / confirmed_attempted_count; null when no attempted items; state unresolved_attempt_count separately
scoring.unresolved_policy: Never count unmeasured or ambiguous items as correct or shrink the fixed denominator. Report unresolved counts and optional score bounds separately. A missed automatic association is requires_review, not proof of absence.
scoring.attempted_definition: The geometrically intended feature exists and can be associated with this criterion, even if incorrect. For a relational criterion all referenced features must exist; for stage-integrity items the relevant cumulative stage model must exist. Do not use candidate declarations as sole evidence.
scoring.full_acceptance: All61criteria correct, required supplemental gates satisfied, clean rebuild/export integrity passed, and no unresolved required review items.
scoring.paper_comparison: Record a frozen35-minute artifact; later completion has a separate timestamp and cannot replace it. CadQuery+feedback is an adaptation of the human Onshape workflow.

tolerance_policy.source_status: The paper provides no numeric acceptance tolerance; every tolerance below is an explicit benchmark convention.
tolerance_policy.rounded_derived_linear: Use the printed0.01mm rounding interval plus0.001mm numerical margin forS1D4,S1D13,S3D2.
tolerance_policy.derived_bore_area: S3D1 uses the printed0.001mm2 rounding interval plus0.1mm2 numerical margin after qualified face association.
tolerance_policy.integer_dimensions: Treat explicit integer nominal dimensions as exact targets subject to0.01mm comparison tolerance; do not invent a±0.5mm rounding interval.
tolerance_policy.missing_or_ambiguous_feature: requires_review or inconclusive; never automatic pass.
tolerance_policy.multiplicity: Every specified instance must pass individually; aggregate with logicalAND.
tolerance_policy.registration: Rigid registration of the complete assembly is allowed; scaling is forbidden. Component-relative placement must be preserved.
tolerance_policy.source_priority: Participant AppendixA determines the task; AppendixB supplies equivalent grading measurements. When their equivalence is unresolved, preserve both evidence and uncertainty rather than overriding participant requirements.
